column1: # done_enemies (batch 6, _todo rows 451-590) — srcline <TAB> english. FINISHES enemies. Realm badges skipped.

column2: A temporary health-drain was hard to implement, so it was changed to 5x vulnerability. The teacher's health bar looks a bit purple — heart trouble, maybe?
To this day we still don't know why the Interception skill can also be squad-amplified.
A balanced fighter covered head to toe in scale armor. If even Suppression can't give you an edge, then you simply couldn't win to begin with!
If a skeleton were made entirely of crystal instead of bone, could it still be called a skeleton?
Mage Tower stereotype #1: anything shaped like a snake or tentacle is definitely there to apply debuffs. This is false.
Mage Tower stereotype #2: winged fellows can always heal themselves. This one's true.
Lawful evil: remember the hexagonal Red Gem on 376F? Making you eat a hexagonal Yellow Gem without checking the map……
Was the last one called "Green Plains" that old geezer from 1-3? Could he really be a hidden master……
A squad better at drawing fire than at swift attacks. Of course, here it's just another roadside nobody.
By rights the 50% aura should be a health-aura or something. But I forgot to make it! Skipped it!
Now do you appreciate Eve? Of course, making a full set of gear is definitely more worth it.
A squad that forces enemies to submit with overwhelming attack speed. You really think you can come out ahead in a melee?
Glass-cannon, easy as pie…… uh-oh! Uh-oh uh-oh!!
A squad favoring defensive arrays…… bro thinks 3.6e10 defense is super strong in 4-2.
Its days are numbered anyway, so why not give one last all-out fight for the family? But your defense is way too low.
You sure you're an elite? A guard's way of testing strength isn't standing there taking hits, is it?
【Call for Aid】 was just too hard to implement. The RPG's 【Defeat Shift】 actually fits that trait better…… so let's just use it! Oh, and the loot is dropped by the mobs it calls in.
The Qingye River Thief changed its name not because it couldn't cut it, but because it got so strong it could rob all across the Yangang Fief.
Who signed it up? Looks like it slipped over from the City Gate Battle while the sentries were being wiped out.
Unlike those earlier fellows who could be bribed, the more money it sees on you, the more it wants to kill and seize your treasure……
An Earth Dragon that, bred as a tamed beast, is now in no way inferior to an ordinary Wyvern. It's just that insight can't be force-fed, so it's stuck at this level.
It looks ferocious and terrifying, but those are just tamed insects. Setting aside its allegiance, it can't really be called a bad person.
Shouldn't a Great-Axe warrior at least be a same-realm Rank 9? Well, looks like he just has a big axe.
The last few squads all had super-high combo counts. Twin-Sword is probably ten people using 2 swords~
It's about time Scattered Bloom got buffed too. Look how high Neko's health has stacked!
With all these multipliers, Time-Seal has somehow become just another roadside nobody! Balance——
The Twin-Sword Squad's attack speed must be what you stole. One more hit than even the Burning Cloud!
Is everyone here? Once they're all assembled, I'm slipping away (^^)
With the same 9e10 defense, some have 1.764e11 attack and think only of fleeing, while others have 1.45e11 attack and charge fearlessly forward……

Actually, the number of enemies in the image hints at the digit-count of the real enemy number (runs away). The XP looks like a lot, but the Skyhigh-Tier bottleneck will eat it for you, then level-suppression eats another 80%~
Now you know why the Mythic gems' health multiplier was raised! As for the health those first few dozen added…… don't sweat the details.
It sounds like [Patrol] ranks below [Sentry], but if I say "invigilator" vs "roving invigilator," everyone gets it.
(Shaxue flipping through Floor 399) (bitterly disappointed). It's such a waste for a prodigy like this not to be in a boss fight……
Uh-oh…… I'd planned to swap Call-for-Aid for Defeat Shift. Nobody told me these two can coexist! Fine, here's a 2-hit combo for you.
Having both such high attack AND Magic Attack…… is this the strength of a Company?
What, you want to fight me for resources? Stab you dead, meow (DMG 50x) stab you dead, meow (DMG 50x) stab you dead, meow (DMG 50x).
160x health/defense is stronger than the 60x Blue-Hat mobs of back then! Though part of the reason is the mob health multiplier keeps climbing……
Report—— 40 of the 100 people in our squad are casting Harden magic! Our attack is way worse than the non-Harden squad next door!!

Bully-the-Weak? Has Baifang really reincarnated?! Skyhigh-Tier lifespan is 10 epochs, so in theory anyone under 3 epochs is a youth…… but not reaching Rank 5 within 1 epoch basically means no shot at Domain-Tier this lifetime.
How many zones has it been already. Someone finally realized mages can heal warriors…… 1.5-rank combat power, that is! No small thing!
How did one that only knows Call-for-Aid rise to general…… or is it actually a scout-type character?
A sneak attack…… payback for turning my kin into Barrier Lake Flesh! Now you see the error of your ways?
Just Restraint? Watch me handle it easily…… wait! What IS this?!!
Look at what soldiers the Cyan Furball General recruited. What a pair…… never mind, just eat them.
【Beast-Taming Breeder】, just how far do your eyes really see? Or has this thing simply betrayed you?
Takes flight~ interrupting your pleasant attacking experience!
Such a waste that it never broke through. A powerhouse like this should have a plus sign even after breaking through.
By rights there should be a mini-BOSS called the Red Fiend. It unlocks after clearing 4-4-2……
More and more tanks! But this special attribute…… if all else fails, how about we learn 【Rend】, a fixed 1.5x Basic Attack Multiplier?
The princess that Mage Tower players toiled so hard to rescue has ended up on the battlefield just like this. A pitiful, lamentable ending.
If you really think this thing is too absurd, go back and eat some Restraint books…… they'll definitely help.
A merciless defense-check bot. In normal zones this kind of guy could be a punching bag and get booted to -4, but this is 4-4 where gimmick monsters fly everywhere, so off to 4-4-3 with you~
Made by Scattered Bloom, undone by Scattered Bloom. The original Scattered Bloom just isn't playable in Act 4 anymore……
Here's 8.1e11 Attack+Defense for you; hope you make it through this winter.
Is this…… really…… a place we should set foot in……
A Na Family Attendant using all its strength. On home turf, it holds nothing back!
A Hundred-Clans footsoldier going all-out to seize the techniques.
A big rock by the city gate. It bears a natural hatred for humans, a fight to the death.
The old man outside the city. He looks down on Neko, yet isn't much stronger than her.
A mercenary guarding the Crypt gate, biding its time. It's already poached many cultivators — deep reserves.
I hear a certain kitty has been stacking Iron Skin...
A very nimble treant; to get close, be ready to first take a lash from each of its 20 charged willow-whips!
A balanced-stat elite Wildbeast, the gatekeeper of the Crypt Core.
Why is this junk BOSS's skin so squishy?! Looks like you could kill it in one blow.
~Full·Health·Version·True·God·Descends~ Powerful, needless to say!
The final BOSS of Act 1. You might not have beaten it even at 2-5 — lucky you had the Laser Gun...
A guard Baifang brought along. Why would the young master bring a guard weaker than himself...
Compared to the Baifang aboard the ship, it's only two ranks lower, yet its stats are over 20 times weaker. The late-Earth-Tier span is way too big.
See, this is what "barging into a great house by mistake" means... how did the 2-4 warrior end up here!
A hard rock blocking the way to the Qingye Waterfall. Friendly reminder: Basic Attack Multiplier is checked AFTER Fortify!
Truly a great sect — even its menial is this strong... the earlier Minor-Faction Explorers were practically dirt-poor!
Already strong enough, and it has an aura too... good thing you can mine the aura away!
Wait? How much health?？
There's a damage-soaker up ahead, hehehehe.
It can deal some damage and also soak damage. Under 4-fold attacks, that seems quite important.
Fighting it head-on will probably get you clobbered by Light-Chase. But Light-Chase only has 3 hits~
Scattered Bloom really is a troublesome insight... Crescent Moon's blessing, or a Magic Attack potion — which do you prefer~
THIS one's the genuine article! But the young master's progress is a bit slow compared to Neko's——
A big one! Hard to fight! But it's a bit slow.
Hah~ Self-Destruct! Let's see who dares turn up their nose at health gems now~
Guarding a hoard that qualifies as 【massive】, and as an important story beat — it got buffed!
The B6 spaceship's main combat hub. Swift movement, formidable combat power. But it's finally the Laser Gun's time to shine.

A Wildbeast skilled in illusions. Not very strong itself, but it can make you lose your way without a trace. Oh, and the 10x fixed token is a mid-Sky-Tier kill reward, while the 4x affected token is dropped by two Elite Mercenaries.
A thick-skinned, tough Wildbeast. What is that reckless fellow over there doing!
What a sloppy name... practically a nobody-extra among Wildbeasts.
It has Time-Seal and 200% health, but 0 defense before Basic Attack Multiplier is~ no match at all!
It's actually not that strong to begin with…… but there are six of them ganging up on you.
Hiding behind a big crowd of Hunter-Soldiers to ambush you! What a wimp……
Quite the punching bag, but that's all it's got left.
Among its own rank it counts as strong, but trying to counter-conquer Neko — did it mix something up?
A good person in the Water Prison. Truly moving……
The ranking powerhouse 【Falling-Leaf Blade】. Currently ranked third — the moment you see this notice, it isn't anymore.
The ranking's publisher, with crushing strength. Though here she only used one of her three Domain tiers……
The ranking's publisher, with crushing strength. With all her Domains out, she's terrifyingly strong, even surpassing the 3+ realm……
Why does the Bestiary come to life?! Also, don't you think Suppression is even more likely than Restraint to become a burden……
A puppet infused with power by a higher-dimensional being. Once Suppression · Pseudo is done testing, it can clock out!
I kept some Sync so you'd know you're fighting the Inner Demon. But it'll still get bullied by Restraint insight, you know!
The color really does resemble Sister's clothes…… now's not the time to think about that!
A pure stat-check monster. I'm guessing if you made it here, you're not too scared of it.
A wisp of the remnant soul of an apocalyptic-Secret-Realm prodigy. Over long ages it lost 99.9999% of its power, leaving only a Sky-Tier Peak ++ energy level……
Skyhigh-Tier Peak [XII] Skyhigh-Tier Rank 1 --
Thank goodness it's not the big-gem version of the Terror-Gu Beast. Another stat-check monster —— perfectly ordinary, right?
A standard Skyhigh-Tier Rank 1 corresponds to Sky-Tier Peak +++. Clearly, this Inner Demon didn't break through normally…… so its realm is unstable, even on the verge of falling.
A Skyhigh-Tier powerhouse shortlisted by Zuo'a as a 【vessel】.
The last remaining wisp of soul is also sealed, leaving 0.01% of its power. For all its scheming, it never foresaw this step…… oh, and it only has Skyhigh-Tier Rank 5 XP. It's way too weak now.
How did you see this line? You cheated, didn't you, punk.
The steaming of persimmons has always been thus…… old thing, your era is over!
Its attack and attack speed are way too high even for Sky-Tier, and it has guaranteed-hit damage. It must have something good on it — this one cannot be left alive……
A hateful fellow trying to block the gate so nobody can get in! It even hides behind a Sky-Tier squad……
A squad better at drawing fire than at swift attacks. Its survivability is absurdly high……
A squad that forces enemies to submit with overwhelming attack speed. But its many attacks are compressed into one more-penetrating hit, so its displayed attack speed isn't that fast.
A squad favoring defensive arrays. Its defense is even a notch above Xueqi's, but its skin is still squishy.
One call rallies a hundred, making each turn's damage more and more outrageous. Oh, and Neko's a bit of a troublemaker — she provoked 3 of them at once~

Once, in the Blood Demon Sea, the Na Family ancestor Na Ying burned his own life to free it. It never forgot such a great kindness; after a friendly spar, it'll tell you how to make the Intermediate Evolution Crystal!

Originally an ordinary dead dog, it became undead after being tainted by the ancient tomb's aura. Its abilities are as in life, and it moves extremely nimbly — but being undead, its life force is a notch weaker.
A pitiful Furball dragged in by the Red Fiend to fill the count. Infused with a little life essence, so it can fight a bit longer — or rather, soak more damage.
The fallen 【Fluttering Butterfly Immortal】. Having infused the Flyfly Furball with life essence, it entered a weakened phase — though it considers this irrelevant.
Phew, this zone was about to have no boss. Had to grab a mob from the zone below…… you've been buffed! Get in there!
